triggers.label: Location
triggers.note: Springs when a creature stands in a given square. Flying creatures do not set it off.

triggers.label: Proximity
triggers.note: Springs when a creature comes within a distance; catches flyers. Magic version normally uses alarm.

triggers.label: Sound
triggers.note: Magic only. Listens with a +15 Listen bonus; requires clairaudience. Beaten by Move Silently or silence.

triggers.label: Visual
triggers.note: Magic only. Sees; requires arcane eye, clairvoyance or true seeing. Fooled by whatever fools that spell.

triggers.label: Touch
triggers.note: Springs when touched. Magic version uses alarm shrunk to the trigger spot.

triggers.label: Spell
triggers.note: Only for spell traps; the spell description sets the trigger conditions.

resets.label: No reset
resets.note: One use only. All spell traps use this.

resets.label: Repair
resets.note: Must be repaired before it works again.

resets.label: Manual
resets.note: Someone moves the parts back. Default for mechanical traps.

resets.label: Automatic
resets.note: Resets itself, at once or after an interval.

averageDamage.rounding: nearest multiple of 7, round up on an exact tie

misc.alchemicalDevice: level of the spell it mimics

magic.rule: Apply whichever is larger: the level of the highest-level spell used, or +1 per 7 points of average damage per round. Never both.

mechanical.formula: (modified base cost x CR) + poison/alchemical extras

oneShot.perSpellGp: 50 gp x caster level x spell level
oneShot.perSpellXp: 4 XP x caster level x spell level

automaticReset.perSpellGp: 500 gp x caster level x spell level
automaticReset.perSpellXp: 40 XP x caster level x spell level
automaticReset.materialComponents: cost of all material components x 100 gp

spell.note: Free unless an NPC spellcaster must be hired to cast it.

repair.rawMaterialsCost: one-fifth of the trap's market price

miscFeatures.label: Gas
miscFeatures.note: Inhaled poison. Usually never miss + onset delay.

miscFeatures.label: Liquid
miscFeatures.note: Drowning risk. Usually never miss + onset delay.

miscFeatures.label: Never miss
miscFeatures.note: No attack roll and no save; always carries an onset delay.

miscFeatures.label: Poison
